map-radius-tool.name: Map Radius Tool
map-radius-tool.description: Draw a radius circle on a map in miles, kilometers, or nautical miles. Measure radius area and export vector boundaries.
map-radius-tool.directAnswer: The Map Radius Tool draws exact geodesic distance circles around any chosen geographic point. Enter an address, use GPS, or click the map, then specify radius distance.

distance-between-two-places.name: Distance Between Two Places
distance-between-two-places.description: Calculate straight-line distance, compass bearing, and midpoint between two locations or addresses.
distance-between-two-places.directAnswer: The Distance Between Two Places calculator computes the geodesic straight-line distance between two points on the WGS84 ellipsoid with true compass bearings.

distance-between-zip-codes.name: Distance Between ZIP Codes
distance-between-zip-codes.description: Distance between two US ZIP codes with population data and interactive map visualization.
distance-between-zip-codes.directAnswer: The Distance Between ZIP Codes tool computes the geodesic distance between two 5-digit US ZIP Code centroids based on US Census Bureau ZCTA data.

distance-between-cities.name: Distance Between Cities
distance-between-cities.description: Distance between two US cities with straight-line distance, driving estimate, and map route.
distance-between-cities.directAnswer: The Distance Between Cities calculator determines the straight-line and highway travel distance between US metropolitan areas and incorporated municipalities.

halfway-between-two-places.name: Halfway Between Two Places
halfway-between-two-places.description: Find the midpoint to meet in the middle between two addresses, cities, or coordinates.
halfway-between-two-places.directAnswer: The Halfway Between Two Places calculator finds the exact geographic midpoint halfway along the shortest geodesic arc between two locations.

crow-flies-distance.name: Crow Flies Distance
crow-flies-distance.description: Straight-line vs driving distance side by side, with detour percentage and travel comparison.
crow-flies-distance.directAnswer: The Crow Flies Distance tool contrasts as-the-crow-flies straight-line geodesic distance against real road driving distance to calculate the routing detour factor.

multi-stop-route-distance.name: Multi-Stop Route Distance
multi-stop-route-distance.description: Total trip mileage across up to 25 waypoints with optional best-order route optimization.
multi-stop-route-distance.directAnswer: The Multi-Stop Route Distance calculator computes total cumulative mileage and drive duration across multiple sequential destinations with optional waypoint reordering.

distance-matrix-calculator.name: Distance Matrix Calculator
distance-matrix-calculator.description: N×N pairwise distance matrix between 2-50 points with heatmap, CSV export, and optional driving distances.
distance-matrix-calculator.directAnswer: The Distance Matrix Calculator generates a full N×N matrix of pairwise geodesic or driving distances between multiple locations, downloadable as a formatted CSV table.

horizon-distance-calculator.name: Horizon Distance Calculator
horizon-distance-calculator.description: How far is the horizon? Distance, dip angle, and visible landmarks by observer eye height from beach to ISS.
horizon-distance-calculator.directAnswer: The Horizon Distance Calculator uses geometric Earth curvature formulas and atmospheric refraction corrections (d ≈ 3.57 × √h km) to determine line-of-sight distance to the horizon.

coordinates-to-city.name: Coordinates to City
coordinates-to-city.description: Lat/lng to city name with state, country, and county worldwide via OpenStreetMap.
coordinates-to-city.directAnswer: The Coordinates to City tool resolves any latitude and longitude into an official municipality, city, or town name with administrative hierarchy.

coordinates-to-country.name: Coordinates to Country
coordinates-to-country.description: Lat/lng to country name with flag emoji, ISO 3166-1 code, capital, and continent.
coordinates-to-country.directAnswer: The Coordinates to Country tool identifies the sovereign nation corresponding to any latitude and longitude coordinate pair worldwide.

coordinates-to-state.name: Coordinates to State
coordinates-to-state.description: Lat/lng to US state name with two-letter abbreviation, county, capital, and ZIP code.
coordinates-to-state.directAnswer: The Coordinates to State tool converts GPS coordinates into official US state and county names, FIPS codes, and regional data.
secondaryKeywords: what state are these coordinates in

latitude-longitude-map.name: Latitude & Longitude Map
latitude-longitude-map.description: Plot coordinates on an interactive world map and inspect latitude/longitude grid lines.
latitude-longitude-map.directAnswer: The Latitude & Longitude Map plots coordinate pins on an interactive canvas, showing graticule parallels and meridians across the globe.

utm-to-lat-long.name: UTM to Lat/Long Converter
utm-to-lat-long.description: Convert UTM northing/easting to latitude/longitude decimal degrees and back with zone detection.
utm-to-lat-long.directAnswer: The UTM to Lat/Long Converter transforms Universal Transverse Mercator grid coordinates into standard WGS84 geographic latitude and longitude.

map-tunnel.name: Map Tunnel
map-tunnel.description: Twin synchronised globes — see exactly where a tunnel through Earth from any city would emerge on the opposite side.
map-tunnel.directAnswer: The Map Tunnel tool simulates drilling straight through the center of the Earth on twin synchronized maps to discover your exact antipodal point.

embed-map.name: Google Maps Embed Code Generator
embed-map.description: Generate responsive iframe code for Google Maps embed — place, directions, or custom view. No API key needed.
embed-map.directAnswer: The Google Maps Embed Code Generator creates free, responsive iframe HTML snippets for embedding interactive maps and location directions onto websites without requiring a Google Cloud billing account or API key.
secondaryKeywords: embed google maps without api key

map-with-legend.name: Map with Legend Maker
map-with-legend.description: Annotate any map with markers, region fills, and a custom auto-generating color legend.
map-with-legend.directAnswer: The Map with Legend Maker allows you to place styled symbols, markers, and polygon fills on a map canvas with a synchronized, editable cartographic legend.

color-a-map.name: Color a Map
color-a-map.description: Click any country, US state, or region to fill it with color groups and export high-res vector maps.
color-a-map.directAnswer: The Color a Map tool allows you to click-to-color world countries, US states, and counties into thematic groupings, perfect for classroom projects, travel maps, and sales territory planning.

country-size-comparison.name: Country Size Comparison
country-size-comparison.description: Overlay and drag true-scale country outlines across the globe to compare actual landmasses without Mercator distortion.
country-size-comparison.directAnswer: The Country Size Comparison tool lets you select any country or US state, pick it up, and drag its true-scale polygon over other nations to see its true physical size without Mercator projection inflation.

map-with-counties.name: Map with Counties
map-with-counties.description: Interactive US county boundary map with search, hover population data, and county coloring tools.
map-with-counties.directAnswer: The Map with Counties displays all 3,143 US counties and county equivalents on an interactive map with FIPS codes, boundaries, and demographic data.

map-with-zip-codes.name: Map with ZIP Codes
map-with-zip-codes.description: Interactive US ZIP code boundary map with search, radius circles, and demographic overlays.
map-with-zip-codes.directAnswer: The Map with ZIP Codes renders US Census ZCTA postal boundaries across all 50 states, allowing users to inspect boundaries, search ZIP codes, and measure radius buffers.

us-county-map-interactive.name: US County Map Interactive
us-county-map-interactive.description: Explore all 3,143 US counties interactively with population, median income, land area, and state filter.
us-county-map-interactive.directAnswer: The US County Map Interactive provides a comprehensive map of every county and parish in the United States, complete with Census population stats and economic indicators.

find-zip-codes-in-radius.name: Find ZIP Codes in Radius
find-zip-codes-in-radius.description: Find all US ZIP codes within a custom mile or kilometer radius of any address, city, or coordinate.
find-zip-codes-in-radius.directAnswer: The Find ZIP Codes in Radius tool lists all 5-digit US postal codes located within an exact circular distance buffer of a specified origin with CSV export.

find-cities-in-radius.name: Find Cities in Radius
find-cities-in-radius.description: Find all incorporated cities, towns, and municipalities within X miles of any location.
find-cities-in-radius.directAnswer: The Find Cities in Radius tool identifies all cities, towns, and metropolitan areas situated within a given distance radius with population rankings.

population-within-radius.name: Population Within Radius
population-within-radius.description: Estimate total population living within any distance circle (1 to 100 miles) in the United States.
population-within-radius.directAnswer: The Population Within Radius calculator estimates total residents living inside a custom radius circle using US Census Bureau block group and tract demographic data.
secondaryKeywords: how many people live within 10 miles

address-to-county-lookup.name: Address to County Lookup
address-to-county-lookup.description: Look up which county an address or property is in, with FIPS codes, county seat, and tax district info.
address-to-county-lookup.directAnswer: The Address to County Lookup determines the official county or parish for any street address in the United States with FIPS identification.
secondaryKeywords: what county is this address in

county-map-with-cities.name: County Map with Cities
county-map-with-cities.description: View US county boundaries with all incorporated cities and major towns plotted and labeled.
county-map-with-cities.directAnswer: The County Map with Cities displays county boundary borders alongside incorporated municipalities and county seats for spatial reference.

find-nearest-national-park.name: Find Nearest National Park
find-nearest-national-park.description: Find which US National Parks and Monuments are closest to you or any entered location with driving distances.
find-nearest-national-park.directAnswer: The Find Nearest National Park tool calculates distances to all 63 official US National Parks and hundreds of National Monuments, ranking them by proximity.

elevation-profile.name: Elevation Profile
elevation-profile.description: Generate topographic elevation cross-section profiles along any drawn path or route with grade percentages.
elevation-profile.directAnswer: The Elevation Profile tool samples topographic digital elevation data along any line or route to generate an altitude profile chart showing grade slope and elevation gain.

us-time-zone-map.name: US Time Zone Map
us-time-zone-map.description: Interactive map of US time zones (Eastern, Central, Mountain, Pacific, Alaska, Hawaii) with current live times.
us-time-zone-map.directAnswer: The US Time Zone Map illustrates standard time zone boundaries across all 50 states with live clocks, Daylight Saving Time observance rules, and county split zones.

world-time-zone-map.name: World Time Zone Map
world-time-zone-map.description: Interactive world map of standard UTC time zones, UTC offsets, and current local times across international borders.
world-time-zone-map.directAnswer: The World Time Zone Map displays all global standard time zones from UTC-12 to UTC+14 with live world clocks and International Date Line visualization.

time-zone-finder.name: Time Zone Finder
time-zone-finder.description: Look up the exact time zone and current local time for any address, city, or GPS coordinate pair.
time-zone-finder.directAnswer: The Time Zone Finder determines the IANA time zone identifier (e.g. America/New_York), UTC offset, Daylight Saving Time status, and current local time for any coordinates.

time-difference-calculator.name: Time Difference Calculator
time-difference-calculator.description: Calculate time difference and meeting overlap between two cities or time zones worldwide.
time-difference-calculator.directAnswer: The Time Difference Calculator computes the exact hour and minute difference between two global locations, highlighting overlapping business working hours.

moon-position-map.name: Moon Position Map
moon-position-map.description: Live lunar sub-lunar position, azimuth, altitude angle, and moon ground track across the globe.
moon-position-map.directAnswer: The Moon Position Map calculates the real-time position of the Moon where it is directly overhead (zenith) on Earth, with lunar azimuth and elevation angles.
secondaryKeywords: where is the moon overhead now

equator.name: Equator
equator.description: Interactive map and guide to Earth’s Equator (0° Latitude), countries crossed, climate, and physics.
equator.directAnswer: The Equator is Earth’s 0° parallel of latitude, spanning 40,075 kilometers (24,901 miles) across 13 countries and dividing the globe into Northern and Southern Hemispheres.

tropic-of-cancer.name: Tropic of Cancer
tropic-of-cancer.description: Interactive map of the Tropic of Cancer (23.4364° N), June Solstice overhead sun position, and countries traversed.
tropic-of-cancer.directAnswer: The Tropic of Cancer is the northernmost latitude on Earth (approx. 23° 26′ N) where the Sun can be directly overhead at solar noon, occurring on the June Solstice.

tropic-of-capricorn.name: Tropic of Capricorn
tropic-of-capricorn.description: Interactive map of the Tropic of Capricorn (23.4364° S), December Solstice overhead sun position, and countries traversed.
tropic-of-capricorn.directAnswer: The Tropic of Capricorn is the southernmost latitude on Earth (approx. 23° 26′ S) where the Sun can be directly overhead at solar noon, occurring on the December Solstice.

arctic-circle.name: Arctic Circle
arctic-circle.description: Interactive map of the Arctic Circle (66.56° N), midnight sun limits, polar night boundaries, and Arctic nations.
arctic-circle.directAnswer: The Arctic Circle marks the latitude (approx. 66° 33′ N) north of which the Sun remains above the horizon for 24 continuous hours on the summer solstice (Midnight Sun).

antarctic-circle.name: Antarctic Circle
antarctic-circle.description: Interactive map of the Antarctic Circle (66.56° S), polar day and night boundaries, and Antarctic territory claims.
antarctic-circle.directAnswer: The Antarctic Circle marks the latitude (approx. 66° 33′ S) south of which the Sun remains above the horizon for at least 24 continuous hours during the Southern Hemisphere summer.

prime-meridian.name: Prime Meridian
prime-meridian.description: Interactive map of the Greenwich Prime Meridian (0° Longitude), GMT/UTC baseline, and countries crossed.
prime-meridian.directAnswer: The Prime Meridian is the line of 0° longitude passing through the Royal Observatory in Greenwich, London, serving as the international baseline for time zones and longitude.

international-date-line.name: International Date Line
international-date-line.description: Interactive map of the International Date Line (approx. 180° Longitude) across the Pacific with zig-zag offsets.
international-date-line.directAnswer: The International Date Line is the internationally recognized zigzag boundary on Earth’s surface where the calendar date advances by one day when traveling westward.
secondaryKeywords: where is the international date line
